output.recommendation: Given the conflicting objectives of energy-efficiency goals versus network availability during mass events, a domain-level policy recommendation could be to implement a dynamic prioritization system that automatically adjusts the ML energy-saving feature based on real-time event predictions and predefined safety zones. This system should also include a rollback mechanism as outlined in [G1], ensuring that manual operations can be swiftly initiated if necessary to maintain network availability during critical events.
output.rationale: This recommendation leverages existing guidelines from UK (UK-TSCOP-2026-V1.1) and EU (EU-EECC-2018 Article 108) to ensure that automated processes are resilient and have a named owner, while also providing for manual intervention in critical situations. It addresses the gap by dynamically adjusting energy-saving features based on event predictions, ensuring both objectives can be met effectively.
